result.title: Assessing the Impact of Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Algorithmic Problem-Solving
result.summary: Competitive programming problems pose distinctive challenges for Large Language Models, as they demand not only proficient code generation but also advanced algorithmic reasoning. This study presents a Retrieval-Augmented Generation approach specifically designed to enhance the capacity of Large Language Models to address such problems. Our approach integrates an embedding-based retrieval mechanism and a similarity search algorithm to identify analogous problems within a knowledge database, employing a dynamically adjusted threshold to mitigate retrieval noise. We conducted an evaluation using the CodeContests dataset, focusing on the test split problems that exhibit similarity to instances from the training split. The experimental framework considered three conditions: (i) problems provided solely with their original descriptions, (ii) problems supplemented with randomly selected examples from the training split, and (iii) problems augmented with similar examples retrieved through the proposed method. In addition, we incorporated a Min-K membership inference analysis to examine whether the generated code solutions were influenced by potential memorization of training data within the evaluated Large Language Models. This complementary perspective enables a deeper understanding of model behavior by distinguishing genuine generalization through retrieval from implicit recall of pretraining samples. Performance was assessed using both pass rates and the CodeForces Elo rating of the problems. The results provide empirical evidence that similarity-based retrieval substantially enhances Large Language Models performance in competitive programming scenarios, offering an scalable framework for improving code generation in algorithmic problem-solving contexts.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建面向竞赛编程的检索增强系统：用 embedding 检索相似题目并以动态阈值抑制检索噪声，在 CodeContests 上对比原始描述、随机样例与检索样例三种条件，并以 Min-K 成员推断区分真实泛化与训练数据记忆。
AI.relevance_reason: 相似度检索加动态阈值过滤噪声的做法，可供核查 LVR 中「何时引入外部证据、如何筛选证据」的阈值式控制；成员推断区分记忆与泛化的思路，也可能借用于检验答案是否真正依赖检索或 latent 内容而非先验记忆。
